text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening, I happened upon Manhattan 
Cafe and Agnes Tachyon talking together—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well—if it isn't Cafe's Trainer. 
Perfect timing. Mind lending me a hand as 
well?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
An "investigation." Have you heard the 
rumors of mysterious phenomena around the 
academy lately? The kind often referred to 
as the "Seven Wonders."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I've been curious for a while now about 
what kind of effects we experience when 
observing them. That's why I asked Cafe to 
come along and help me investigate."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't you just do this by yourself...? 
Why drag me into it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so cold, Cafe~. I selected you 
because I have high hopes for your 
aptitudes as an event observer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides... heh-heh. There is someone who 
is likely being influenced by you! Which 
means we can expect even greater results!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come along, everyone! Let us embark on a 
journey into the uncharted! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. Once she gets like this, she 
won't listen. I'm sorry, Trainer, but 
could you humur her for a bit...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up accompanying Agnes 
Tachyon on an impromptu paranormal 
investigation tour of the academy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The rooftop in the evening. Someone is 
dancing over on the other side, but... 
it's hard to make out from here with the 
setting sun in my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Case 1: "The Black Shadow Dancing on the 
Rooftop." Though it seems... this one's a 
bust.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There are no moving objects that could be 
mistaken for dancing shadows... and it's 
hard to believe anything was missed in 
this bright light.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Oh well, no matter! There are plenty more 
rumors. Let us move briskly along to the 
next one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite feeling an intense sense of 
unease, I continued to follow behind Agnes 
Tachyon as she led the way—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Case 4: 'Weeping Heard in the Hallway at 
Night.' ...............All clear here too, 
huh. Next!

text_block_list.name: Cries Echoing in the Hallway
text_block_list.text: *sniffle*... *sob*... *weep*...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Case 9: 'Eerie Sounds Resonating from the 
Tree Hollow.' Mmm... Nothing unusual here 
either...!?

text_block_list.name: Sound Echoing from Hollow
text_block_list.text: Oooooooooooooo...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph. To think we wandered this much and 
couldn't observe a single plausible 
phenomenon! I had high hopes since I was 
with you all, but... what a shame.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was all so strange to me, but while 
hesitating over whether to speak up about 
it, I ended up walking a full lap around 
the academy...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Is that all? Well then, we'll be taking 
our leave—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait! From here on, it's Plan B. 
I've learned that behavioral observations 
centered on myself yield no results. 
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Let's hear your opinion. Adding 
a new perspective to our past observation 
methods will eliminate my cognitive 
biases."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, what do you think I should do next?
choice_data_list: Just make a clean break and give up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph. So from your perspective, we've run 
out of moves for tonight, is that it? Then 
we shall follow your judgment and call it 
a day.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Dragging me around everywhere like that... 
You're far too pushy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I do apologize for that. Even I 
didn't expect it to be such a total swing 
and a miss.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Observing Café like usual would have been 
far more meaningful than this. Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ............What a self-centered person.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Thank you... for keeping her 
company today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Manhattan Cafe walked back to the dorm 
alongside Agnes Tachyon, there seemed to 
be something... warm about the sight.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, hardly a suggestion befitting a 
trainer! And yet, I like it. I like it 
very much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, let's verify all 
the rumors once more. The time of day 
might be a factor as well. You'll join me, 
of course, Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......If you say so, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! All thanks to your Trainer, huh! I 
can't wait to see how it turns out this 
time—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Please don't tell Tachyon-san about 
what you saw and heard today, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't think she would... accept it or be 
happy about it... unless she sees it for 
herself...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
――Heeeey, you two! Hurry on over! Time is 
limited, after all!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ............Shall we be on our way?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the phenomenon Agnes Tachyon 
hoped for never occurred, but the night 
offered a glimpse into the curious bond 
and dynamic between the two...
